name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)
description: Old age pension scheme for unorganized workers like street vendors, rickshaw pullers, construction workers.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC

criteria.description: Entry age must be at least 18 years
Entry age must not exceed 40 years
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is older than 40 years for entry into PM-SYM
Annual income exceeds ₹1,80,000 limit for unorganized workers

criteria.description: Must be an unorganized worker or labourer
criteria.disqualification_reason: Scheme only applies to unorganized workers
